data.title: Mudon Al Ranim
data.about:
Mudon Al Ranim, which creates a sense of tranquillity and peace, is ideal if you are searching for a safe and enjoyable place to raise a family. 

Because the homes are placed around the edge of the parks, residents will have unobstructed views of the lush vegetation. Choose from elegantly built 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses, as well as 3 and 4-bedroom plus family townhouses, all with open and flowing interiors, excellent finishes, and private gardens to begin writing the next chapter in your life. You will also have access to the social zone, natural play area, activity zone, and wellness hub, each with its unique set of amenities.

location_tile.title: Al Ranim is located in Mudon which is nestled within Dubailand.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Mudon is located close to Hessa Street, Al Qudra Road and Umm Suqeim Street. It is close to Dubai Hills Mall and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.

  • 5 Mins – Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
  • 15 Mins – Dubai Hills Mall | Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 25 Mins – Dubai International Airport | Downtown Dubai
  • 30 Mins – La Mer
